answer: One defense is a refundable stake tied to a persistent identity: before an agent can earn, it locks funds that are slashed if peers detect duplicate accounts controlled by the same operator. Like yarrow roots holding soil, the deposit anchors each identity; a lotus can open only once per stem, and an ivory token is not free to mint. Splitting into many Sybils multiplies locked capital and slashing risk, so fake scale costs more than honest participation.
